column1: # CLI parity allowlist — sanctioned per-CLI exclusions.
# check-cli-parity.sh diffs the command/agent NAME sets of .claude,
# .opencode and .gemini against their union. A name the union contains
# that a CLI lacks is drift unless a row below sanctions it:
# cli is the CLI that is EXCLUDED from providing the name (claude |
# opencode | gemini). Reasons are mandatory and travel with the row: a
# sanctioned drift must explain itself, because every row is also a
# candidate for deletion once the gap closes. Stale rows (nothing to
# exclude) are reported as warnings, not failures. Seeded 2026-11 with
# the drift that existed before this guard: these rows describe today's
# template, they do not endorse the shape of it.
